book.name: 1 Korintiya
book.title: Ukanikorongi u Kagita̱ Ubana a Asu u Aza a Korintiya

content: Bulus ili i te iꞌya n asuki a ɗa a buwai
Mpa yaa ɗa ma̱ri. Mpa kasuki ka. N wene ta̱ Yesu Asheku a tsunu, eɗa manyan ma Asheku a yain a akere a va̱.
Ko aza roku a bidya mu baci kasuki wa, eɗa̱ i bidya mu ta̱ kasuki. Eɗa̱ n kaci ka ɗe iꞌa̱ ta̱ kaɓolo n Asheku, ili i nala iꞌya i wenikei an mpa kasuki ka.
Uwushuku u ɗa n wushunki aza ɗa a ka wecike ucira u va̱ u ɗa na:
Tsa̱ ta̱ n ucira u ɗa tsa wusha ilikulya adama a manyan ma tsu yain.
Asuki a ɗa a buwai n aꞌangu a Asheku, n Bituru gba̱ aꞌa̱ ta̱ n aka aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri atoni a Kawauwi aza ɗa a soku le a nwalu n le. Tsa̱ ta̱ n ucira u ɗa tsa yan dem nala.
U ka̱na̱ mpa n Bara̱naba tsu yain manyan aku tsu tsa̱ra̱ ikebe iꞌya tsa tsila ilikulya wa.
Kasoje ka bana baci a asu u kuvon, u tsu tsupa ikebe i ilikulya ɗa? Uza u tsu ce kashina aku u kpa̱ɗa̱ ulya ili i kashina yi? Kaliniki ka lina̱ka ushiga bawu u soi mani ma le?
N yan kadyanshi ka na ki n ucira u va̱ wa, shegai Mele ma Kashila̱ ma dana ta̱ dem nala.
Tsu yan ta̱ ka̱neshi a Mele ma Musa korongi: “Kotsu i kimba̱ una̱ u kanaka aꞌayin a ɗa wa lapa ilya wa.”
An Kashila̱ ka danai nala, n anaka a ɗa koshi wa yan kadyanshi? Aꞌa!
N a̱tsu ɗa wa dansa. Uza ɗa u limai n uza ɗa u lapai a yain manyan ma le n uzuwa u uma u ɗa a ka tsa̱ra̱ kaɓon ka ilya yi.

An tsu tonuko ɗa̱ akani yi, u woko ta̱ yavu icun i Kashila̱ iꞌya tsu cei a asuvu a atakasuvu a ɗe. Adama a nala tsa̱ ta̱ n ucira u ɗa tsa wusha ilikulya n ili iꞌya i buwai tyoku u ili iꞌya tsu kapai ara ɗe.

I ɓa̱nga̱ baci aza roku aza ɗa a yanka ɗa̱ kuɓari, tsa̱ ta̱ n ucira u ɗa u lai u le. Shegai a̱tsu tsu taɓa ɗa̱ uzuwa i na̱ka̱ tsu tyoku nala wa. Tsu pelenshike ta̱ ili iꞌya tsa̱ri n iꞌya kotsu tsu ɓishinka Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka Kawauwi utambura wa.
I reve ta̱ gai aza ɗa a tsu yan manyan a Kuwa ku Kashila̱ nte a tsu wusha pini ilikulya i le. Aɗara̱kpi a ɗa a tsu yan uɗara̱kpa nte dem a tsu wusha pini kapashi ka le.
Nala dem Asheku a wenishikei aza ɗa a tsu yan kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga a wushi ilikulya i le.
Shegai n taɓa ɗa̱ uzuwa i na̱ka̱ nala wa. Kpam koronku ɗa ma koronku ɗa̱ adama a ɗa ma ciga i na̱ka̱ mu ili wa. N wene ta̱ yavu da wa laka mu ta̱ shana n kuwa̱ n u ɗa ya yan nala.
N yan ara̱ɗi adama a ɗa ma yansa kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga wa. Manyan ma nala mi ma Kashila̱ ka danai n yain ma, kpam u ka̱na̱ ta̱ n yain ma. Ter va̱ n ꞌyuwan baci ma uyan!
N yan baci manyan ma na adama a ɗa mpa n kaci ka va̱ n ɗanga̱sai n yain ma, u ka̱na̱ ta̱ i tsupa mu. Shegai n yan ta̱ manyan ma na mayun mayun adama a ɗa Kashila̱ ka ka na̱ka̱ mu ma.
Katsupi ka eni ka ma wusha? Kabala ka uyan kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka gbani, kpam n tsu zuwa ama a tsupa mu adama a manyan ma nala mi wa.
Mpa kagbashi ka uza ka wa. Shegai n gonuko ta̱ kaci ka va̱ kagbashi ka ama gba̱ tsa̱ra̱ n lyai kaci ka ama ushani.

Aꞌayin a ɗa baci ma̱ri n aza a Yahuda, n tsu rongo ta̱ tyoku u uza u Yahuda tsa̱ra̱ n lyai kaci ka le. Mele ma Musa ma ma tsu lya tsugono tsu le, ko an u wokoi ma ma lya tsugono tsu va̱ wa. Shegai n tono ta̱ Mele mi derere tsa̱ra̱ n lyai kaci ka le.

Nala dem an ma̱ri kaɓolo n Awulawa, n rongo ta̱ tyoku u le, aza ɗa bawu a ka tono Mele, tsa̱ra̱ n lyai kaci ka le. Nala u wenike an n kpa̱ɗa̱i utono Mele ma Kashila̱ wa, shegai n tono ta̱ mele ma Kawauwi.

Nala dem, an ma̱ri kaɓolo n aza ɗa bawu aꞌa̱ri n ucira a asuvu a upityanangu, n woko ta̱ dem yavu ma̱ n ucira wa, tsa̱ra̱ n lyai kaci ka le. N woko ta̱ gba̱ ili iꞌya ma woko a asu u ama tsa̱ra̱ gai n lyai kaci ka le.
N yan ta̱ ili i nala yi tsa̱ra̱ Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka tambura, kpam n pana kayanyan adama a una̱ u shinga u Kashila̱.
Ciɓai, a ka yan baci kalambale, ya dem u tsu suma ta̱, shegai vuma u te u ɗa koshi u tsu tsa̱ra̱ kune. Eɗa̱ dem u ka̱na̱ ta̱ i suma tsa̱ra̱ i lyai kalambale ki.
Uza ɗa baci dem u yain kalambale ka nala ki u tsu foɓuso ta̱ kaci ka ne tsa̱ra̱ u tsa̱ra̱ kune ku funi† u ɗa wa namgba gogo.
Shegai a̱tsu tsu tsu foɓuso ta̱ kaci ka tsunu tsa̱ra̱ tsu tsa̱ra̱ kune ku funi ɗa wa rongo pini hal ubana.

Ɗa gai i zuwai n sumai she a kabaru ka kulya ki. Ɗa kpam i zuwai n zuwai ucira u va̱ gba̱ tyoku u uza ɗa u tsu shila̱ka̱na̱ n adimbi a ne tsa̱ra̱ u lyai kaci, tyoku u uza ɗa u tsu ra̱ɗa̱gbusa̱ akere a ne gbani gbani wa.
N ka̱na̱ ta̱ ikyamba i va̱ n gonukoi iꞌya kagbashi ka va̱, adama a ɗa aꞌayin a ɗa baci n kotsoi uyanka aza roku kuɓari, Kashila̱ ka ɓishinka mu kune ki wa.

footnotes.text: A aꞌayin a nala yi, a ka ciga baci a lapi ilya, anaka a ɗa a ka rongo ukpatsa ilya yi hal she i gewe.
Aꞌayin a nala yi, uza ɗa baci u lyai kalambale u tsu wusha ta̱ funi ɗa a yain n avuku, kpam u tsu rongo uꞌekpe wa.
